name: Campbellsville University
tuition_note: 2026-27 tuition & fees from campbellsville.edu/admission-and-aid/financial-aid/tuition-and-fees.html: full-time tuition $14,880/semester + technology fee $150 + student activities fee $100 = $15,130/semester x2 = $30,260/year (private single rate). Room only from same page: lowest standard rate (North/Stapp/South Hall West) $4,884/semester x2 = $9,768/year; no separate board/meal dollar amount published.
